event_summary: A gray round object enters from the left, meets the brown and orange objects on the tabletop, and the orange sphere moves rightward out of frame while the gray and brown objects remain near the center.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a light-colored tabletop, a dark brown small round object positioned immediately left of an orange sphere near the upper middle area, and a partially visible black cylinder at the far left edge. After an initial still period, a small gray round object appears from the left side and moves rightward across the tabletop. It reaches the position of the brown object and the adjacent orange sphere. After this meeting, the orange sphere separates and moves rightward toward the right edge until it leaves the frame. The gray and brown objects stay visible near the central area with little visible change afterward.

reasons: The tabletop and the initially present brown and orange objects are clearly visible.
The gray moving object is not yet visible in the first frame.
The camera view shows the relevant tabletop area before the moving object enters.
